title: Thread a new option through three modules
instruction: In the repository at the current working directory, add support for an option named `verbose` that must flow from src/config.mjs through src/run.mjs into src/log.mjs. Requirements: (1) src/config.mjs's `loadConfig(input)` must default `verbose` to false when the input omits it; (2) src/run.mjs's `run(input)` must pass `config.verbose` to `emit(message, options)`; (3) src/log.mjs's `emit(message, options)` must return the message unchanged when options.verbose is false, and return the message prefixed with `[verbose] ` when true. Do not change any other behaviour.
